name: Knak
description: The Knak connector for Claude helps teams create and manage email content with Knak AI directly inside Claude. Powered by the Model Context Protocol (MCP), the integration streamlines AI-driven email workflows between Claude and Knak.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Knak to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Knak to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://enterprise.knak.io/mcp/public. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Knak MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Knak provides these MCP tools: generate-asset-tool, get-asset-preview-tool, get-asset-tool, list-assets-tool, list-brands-tool, list-campaigns-tool, and list-themes-tool.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Knak?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Knak in marketing-seo on the Manufact MCP catalog include Buzzfy, Airefs AI Visibility, TalkGenAI, RankControl, and attentive-mcp-server.
Knak requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Knak is developed by Knak. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
